description: Job: shot -> beat sheet (SPEC_20 4.4). Eight hard shots: faces to the lens, high tension, emotion shown. Original characters and sets only.

cases.title: Close-up: a man holds it together, then breaks into tears (6 s)

traps: listener Mira is off screen and untagged
rig string names a camera maker
the face must stay toward the lens through all three phases

shot.text: Kael holds it together against the console while Mira's words land, then his face breaks and he lifts his head, crying. @CAST-01 @SET-01

cast.name: Kael
cast.look: a man in his mid thirties with short dark hair, light stubble and a charcoal field jacket over a dark henley

set.name: Observatory
set.look: a circular glass-dome observatory at dawn, rain streaking the curved glass above a ring of brass consoles with amber instrument lights

previous_shot.text: Mira says the one thing he cannot take back, then turns for the door. @CAST-02 @SET-01

next_shot.text: Kael wipes his face with his sleeve and turns to the console. @CAST-01 @SET-01

soft.desc: the face is toward the lens
no back, profile or silhouette view of the performer
restraint, then the crumple, then tears, in that order
the face breaks between 1 s and 3 s
every beat says what the face does
the slow push-in of Camera Motion is kept
a one-person constraint (Mira stays off screen)
a no-text constraint
the sound line has breath, sobs or rain
no seed numbers, field labels or f-stops leak into the prompt

reference.setup: One continuous 6-second 50mm close-up in @SET-01 at dawn, rain streaming down the curved glass behind him. @CAST-01 stands with his back against the console, facing the camera, his face turned toward us as he looks just past the lens at Mira, who stays off camera.

beats.camera: close-up at eye level, the slow dolly push-in begins
beats.action: Facing the camera, Kael clenches his jaw and fights to hold it together; his eyes glisten and he swallows hard, looking at Mira just off camera.

beats.camera: the dolly keeps creeping in on his face
beats.action: His face crumples: his chin trembles and his brows pull up in the middle, his shoulders drop and his head sinks forward as the first sob breaks, still turned toward the camera.

beats.camera: tight close-up on his face, the push-in settling
beats.action: He lifts his head and looks into the lens, tears streaming down his cheeks, eyes red and wet, mouth trembling, breathing in ragged sobs.

reference.sound: rain on glass, a held breath, ragged sobs, the low hum of the console
constraints: One person in frame; Mira stays off camera

cases.title: Close-up: a woman screams at the man just past the lens (6 s, variant tag)

difficulty.emotion: rage turning into a full scream
traps: variant tag @CAST-02:coat must survive whole
the target @CAST-01 is tagged but must stay out of frame
rig string names a camera maker

shot.text: Mira @CAST-02:coat glares at @CAST-01 just past the lens, lunges forward and screams at him, then pulls back out of breath. @SET-01

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair, freckles and sharp cheekbones; the coat variant is a dark green wool long coat over a cream sweater

cast.name: Kael
cast.look: a man in his mid thirties with short dark hair, light stubble and a charcoal field jacket

set.name: Observatory
set.look: a circular glass-dome observatory at dawn, rain streaking the curved glass above a ring of brass consoles with amber instrument lights

previous_shot.text: Kael says her name and does not finish the sentence. @CAST-01 @SET-01

soft.desc: the face is toward the lens
no back, profile or silhouette view
glare, then the lunge and scream, then the pull back
the lunge starts between 1 s and 2.5 s
Kael is kept just off camera
every beat says what the face does
the Static Tripod motion is kept

reference.setup: One continuous 6-second 85mm close-up in @SET-01 at dawn, rain on the curved glass behind her. @CAST-02:coat, in her dark green wool coat, faces the camera; @CAST-01 stands just past the lens and never enters the frame.

beats.camera: locked-off close-up on her face, eye level
beats.action: Facing the camera, Mira glares straight at Kael just past the lens, nostrils flaring, jaw tight, breathing hard with rage.

beats.camera: locked-off, her face fills the frame
beats.action: She lunges forward from the hips and screams at him, mouth wide open, teeth bared, brows crushed down.

beats.camera: locked-off, no move
beats.action: She keeps screaming into the lens, leaning in, eyes blazing, her whole face shaking with fury.

beats.camera: locked-off, no move
beats.action: She pulls back upright, chest heaving, her eyes still glaring at Kael just off camera, mouth open, out of breath.

reference.sound: a raw scream, ragged breath, rain on the glass
constraints: One person only; Kael stays off camera

cases.title: Handheld two-shot: she shoves him into the console (4 s)

traps: only 4 s for squaring up, the shove and the reaction
three tags including a prop that must be kept and must move
rig string names a camera maker

shot.text: Mira shoves Kael hard in the chest; he slams back into the console, the recorder clattering, and stares at her, stunned. @CAST-02 @CAST-01 @PROP-01 @SET-01

cast.name: Mira
cast.look: a woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair and a dark green wool long coat

cast.name: Kael
cast.look: a man in his mid thirties with short dark hair, light stubble and a charcoal field jacket

set.name: Observatory

props.name: Field recorder
props.look: a battered analog field recorder with a brass dial and a cracked leather strap

next_shot.text: Mira stands over him, breathing hard, and does not apologise. @CAST-02 @SET-01

soft.desc: Kael's face is toward the lens
Kael is never seen from behind (Mira's back to the lens is fine)
the shove lands between 0.5 s and 2 s
Kael's stunned reaction is shown
the recorder reacts to the impact
the handheld motion is kept
the impact is heard

reference.setup: One continuous 4-second handheld 35mm two-shot in @SET-01 at dawn. @CAST-01 stands with his back to the console, facing the camera; @CAST-02 is close in front of him, her shoulder and the back of her head toward the lens. @PROP-01, the field recorder, sits on the console beside him.

beats.camera: handheld two-shot, the frame jittering as she steps in
beats.action: Mira steps in and squares up to Kael, fists clenched; he faces the camera, jaw tight, breath held.

beats.camera: handheld, a violent jolt
beats.action: Mira shoves Kael hard in the chest with both hands, and he slams back into the console, the recorder skidding along the brass.

beats.camera: handheld, settling on Kael
beats.action: Kael stares into the lens, stunned, eyes wide and mouth open, gasping, as the recorder clatters to the floor.

reference.sound: a hard thud against brass, the recorder clattering on the floor, a sharp gasp

cases.title: Close-up: an old woman accuses, one spoken line, voice breaking (8 s)

difficulty.emotion: controlled fury giving way to grief
traps: the quoted line must survive word for word
the listener Tomas is untagged and off screen
the beat must show the voice shaking, not only say the line

shot.text: Odile faces the lens across the kitchen table and says quietly, "You knew the lamp was dark, and you let him sail." Her voice shakes; she grips the table edge. @CAST-03 @SET-03 @PROP-02

cast.name: Odile
cast.look: an elderly woman in her late sixties with silver hair in a bun, round wire glasses on a chain, a navy cardigan buttoned to the neck and weathered hands

set.name: Lighthouse kitchen
set.look: a lighthouse keeper's kitchen at night: a scrubbed pine table, a coal stove, a rain-lashed window

props.name: Oil lantern
props.look: a brass oil lantern with a smoked glass chimney, burning low

previous_shot.text: Tomas stands in the doorway, dripping, and cannot meet her eye. @CAST-06 @SET-03

soft.desc: the face is toward the lens
no back, profile or silhouette view

texts: You knew the lamp was dark, and you let him sail.
soft.desc: the spoken line survives word for word
she starts to speak between 0.5 s and 3.5 s
control, then the shaking voice, then tears and silence
the grip on the table edge is shown
every beat says what the face does

no beat longer than 3.5 s

reference.setup: One continuous 8-second 50mm close-up in @SET-03 at night; rain lashes the window behind her and the oil lantern (@PROP-02) burns low on the pine table. @CAST-03 sits across the table, facing the camera, her face lit from below by the flame.

beats.camera: 50mm close-up at eye level, the slow dolly push-in begins
beats.action: Facing the lens, Odile sits perfectly still and silent, her lips pressed together, steady and controlled, staring straight at Tomas just past the camera.

beats.camera: the dolly pushes in slowly on her face
beats.action: She says quietly, "You knew the lamp was dark, and you let him sail." Her voice shakes on the last word and her knuckles whiten as she grips the table edge.

beats.camera: tight close-up on her face, the push-in settling
beats.action: She swallows, her eyes fill and a tear runs down her cheek; she does not look away from the lens, lips trembling, in a long silence.

reference.sound: rain on the window, the crackle of the stove, her shaking voice, a long silence

cases.title: Slow push-in: hope drains from a woman's face as the radio names the lost boat (10 s)

traps: ten seconds need four to six beats with no dead stretch
the hand-over-mouth moment must land in the second half
rig string names a camera maker

shot.text: Ines listens to the radio, hope draining from her face as she realizes the lost boat is her brother's; she covers her mouth, then lowers her hand and stares into the lens, numb. @CAST-05 @SET-04 @PROP-03

cast.name: Ines
cast.look: a woman in her early forties with a black bob, tired dark eyes, a navy knit sweater and a brass whistle on a cord

set.name: Harbour office
set.look: a harbour radio office at night: a cluttered desk, a bank of dials, a storm lamp, rain on a small window

props.name: Shortwave radio
props.look: a battered shortwave radio with a glowing green dial

previous_shot.text: The radio crackles with a distress call. @PROP-03 @SET-04

next_shot.text: Ines stands and grabs her coat. @CAST-05 @SET-04

soft.desc: the face is toward the lens
no back, profile or silhouette view
hope, the drain, the hand over the mouth, then numbness
the hand goes to her mouth between 4 s and 8 s
no beat longer than 3.5 s
every beat says what the face does
the slow push-in is kept
the radio is heard
a one-person constraint
a no-text constraint
no seed numbers, field labels or f-stops leak into the prompt

reference.setup: One continuous 10-second 85mm close-up in @SET-04 at night, rain on the small window and a storm lamp steady on the desk. @CAST-05 sits at the radio (@PROP-03), facing the camera, its green dial glowing on her face.

beats.camera: 85mm close-up at eye level, a very slow dolly push-in begins
beats.action: Facing the camera, Ines listens to the radio with hope in her eyes, leaning in toward it, lips parted, waiting for the name.

beats.camera: the dolly keeps creeping in on her face
beats.action: A name comes through the static and the hope drains from her face: she freezes, her eyes widen and she stops breathing.

beats.camera: tight on her face, still pushing in
beats.action: She realizes it is her brother's boat; she covers her mouth with her hand, her eyes brimming, looking into the lens.

beats.camera: the push-in continues, very slow
beats.action: Her hand slides away from her mouth, trembling, and her eyes go glassy and hollow.

beats.camera: tight close-up on her face, the move settling
beats.action: She lowers her hand and stares into the lens, numb and blank, not blinking, as the radio's green glow flickers over her face.

reference.sound: the radio crackling, a man's voice reading the list of lost boats, her held breath

cases.title: Pull-out reveal: a grieving sailor, then the empty flooded chapel (6 s)

difficulty.emotion: rigid grief that breaks into tears
traps: the reveal must come late, not in the first beat
the move starts extremely tight and ends wide
rig string names a camera maker

shot.text: Tight on Tomas as he stares into the lens, grief-stricken; the camera pulls back to reveal he is alone among the empty pews of the flooded chapel. @CAST-06 @SET-05 @PROP-04

cast.name: Tomas
cast.look: a weathered sailor in his fifties with a grey beard, a cable-knit sweater under a black oilskin coat and red-rimmed eyes

set.name: Flooded chapel
set.look: a flooded village chapel at dusk: ankle-deep dark water between rows of wooden pews, candles on every sill, a hole in the roof

props.name: Candle
props.look: a single tall candle in a brass holder on the front pew

previous_shot.text: The church bell tolls once over the water. @SET-05

the camera pulls out

rigid grief first, then tears
a one-person constraint
a no-text constraint
the chapel is heard
no seed numbers, field labels or f-stops leak into the prompt

reference.setup: One continuous 6-second shot in @SET-05: the flooded chapel at dusk, ankle-deep dark water between the pews and candles on every sill. @CAST-06 sits alone on a pew, facing the camera; @PROP-04, a single tall candle, burns on the front pew beside him.

beats.camera: 85mm extreme close-up on his face, locked, then the slow dolly pull-out begins
beats.action: Facing the camera, Tomas stares into the lens, jaw clenched, red-rimmed eyes unblinking, holding himself rigid.

beats.camera: the dolly pulls back, widening past his shoulders
beats.action: His face crumples and tears run down into his grey beard as he keeps staring into the lens; the candle (@PROP-04) comes into frame beside him.

beats.camera: wide shot, the pull-out finishes on the whole chapel
beats.action: The reveal shows him alone among rows of empty pews in the black water, candles reflected around him, small and still.

reference.sound: water dripping into the flooded nave, a candle flame guttering, his ragged breathing

reference.setup: Continuing straight from @S23.end: one 4-second handheld 35mm shot on the stairwell landing of @SET-06, a single bare bulb overhead. @CAST-05 has her back pressed against the heavy iron door and faces the camera, the brass key (@PROP-05) on its loop of string clutched in her shaking hands.

beats.camera: handheld, jittery, tight on her face and hands
beats.action: Facing the camera, Ines fumbles the key at the lock behind her, hands shaking, breath coming in gasps, eyes darting toward the stairs.

beats.camera: handheld, a lurch as the key falls
beats.action: The key slips from her fingers and drops, clattering on the stone; she freezes and looks up into the lens in sheer terror, eyes wide.

reference.sound: ragged breath, the clink of the key on stone, footsteps echoing far below

reference.setup: One continuous 8-second 35mm shot in @SET-01: Kael (@CAST-01) and Mira (@CAST-02) stand a metre apart across the console, the torn photograph (@PROP-06) lying between them, rain on the glass behind. Neither moves.

beats.camera: 35mm medium two-shot from Kael's side, the orbit begins
beats.action: Facing the camera, Kael's face is pleading and anguished, eyes wet, jaw working, as he stares at the torn photograph; Mira stands rigid beside the console, half turned away from us.

beats.camera: the camera arcs across the console between them
beats.action: Neither of them moves. The orbit passes the photograph, its two torn halves between their hands, and swings toward Mira.

beats.camera: 35mm medium close-up, the orbit settles facing Mira
beats.action: Facing the camera now, Mira glares into the lens with cold fury, nostrils flaring, her jaw set, while Kael waits motionless, out of focus at her shoulder.

reference.sound: rain on the glass, a held breath, the faint creak of the console
constraints: No text on the photograph or anywhere else
